name: Raffles Shenzhen
positioning: Raffles hotel on the top floors of the One Shenzhen Bay Office Building in Nanshan District, with views over the city and bay
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor base in Nanshan District with city and bay views
Guests who value a Raffles Butler on hand 24 hours a day
Event planners who need a pillarless ballroom, meeting rooms or the Sky Concert Hall

facts.text: The rooms and suites are arranged over the top floors of the One Shenzhen Bay Office Building, with views over the city and bay.
The hotel is in Nanshan District, a short distance from Qianhai.
The hotel is within walking distance of the Shenzhen Bay Port.
Yun Jing restaurant is on the 70th floor of the 72-storey tower.
Yun Jing features artworks by Colombian artist Gustavo Velez.
The Sky Concert Hall hosts events such as fashion shows, concerts and gala dinners.
The event venues include a pillarless grand ballroom and eight meeting rooms.
The fitness centre has Technogym equipment, an indoor swimming pool and personal training sessions.
The wellness facilities include a Jacuzzi, vitality pool and sauna in a natural-light environment.
A Raffles Butler is on hand 24 hours a day.
The suites showcase contemporary Chinese and Western design.
The Encounter Art over the Bay package includes a helicopter tour over Nantou Ancient City.

highlights.text: The hotel's Sky Concert Hall is listed by Guinness World Records as the world's highest professional concert hall.
Yun Jing has 10 private dining rooms, each inspired by a different precious gemstone.
The hotel's sky helipad is also used as an entertaining space above the city.
The Long Bar serves the signature Singapore Sling with views of Shenzhen Bay and the city.
The Encounter Art over the Bay package includes a Tai Chi session on the hotel's rooftop helipad.

considerations.text: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport is around 40 minutes' drive from the hotel.
The Encounter Art over the Bay package must be reserved at least two weeks in advance.
WhataHotel notes the urban location may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
